scripts.verify:tower: npm run verify:voice && npm run verify:acars
scripts.test:voice: npm run verify:voice && npm test --prefix ../KSCTowerNetwork-voice-bridge/voice-bridge && npm test --prefix web
scripts.test:acars: npm run verify:acars && npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix web
scripts.dev:clean-ports: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ports = 45173,48787,47372,47373; $listeners = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -in $ports } | Select-Object -Unique LocalPort,OwningProcess; foreach ($row in $listeners) { try { Stop-Process -Id $row.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction Stop } catch {} }"
scripts.dev: %npm_node_execpath% %npm_execpath% run dev:clean-ports && concurrently -n backend,web,bridge -c blue,green,magenta "%npm_node_execpath% %npm_execpath% run dev --prefix backend" "%npm_node_execpath% %npm_execpath% run dev --prefix web" "%npm_node_execpath% %npm_execpath% run dev --prefix ../KSCTowerNetwork-voice-bridge/voice-bridge"
